_meta.description: Called by the 'Appraisal Review Extractor' Copilot Studio agent, AFTER the agent has already extracted and validated the 17 credit-risk data points itself (via an inline Prompt action inside the topic — see agent/appraisal-agent-topic.yaml). This flow does no extraction and makes no AI Builder / generative call of any kind. It only: copies the bank's own appraisal review template to a new, uniquely named workbook, writes the already-extracted values into that workbook's named cells (sheet 'RE Collateral'), and returns a link to the new file.
_meta.invokedBy: Appraisal Review Extractor (Copilot Studio agent), via InvokeFlowAction — not called over HTTP by other flows/agents
connectors: SharePoint (shared_sharepointonline) — Copy file, Get file properties, Create sharing link — run on every request, this template creates a new file per review
Excel Online (Business) (shared_excelonlinebusiness) — Run script, to populate the named cells listed in _meta.cellMap
costNotes: This flow's connector list is SharePoint and Excel Online (Business) only — no AI Builder connector, no Azure OpenAI, no Azure AI Document Intelligence, no Azure Function. It cannot spend a generative/AI Builder credit under any input, because it has no action capable of calling a model.

All extraction happens upstream, inside the Copilot Studio topic (agent/appraisal-agent-topic.yaml), via an inline Prompt action configured directly on that topic step rather than a separately published AI Builder catalog Prompt. That inline call is still a generative/LLM call — it is billed as Copilot Studio generative/message consumption, not eliminated. What this redesign removes is a *separately managed AI Builder resource* and *any AI Builder connector call inside this flow* — not the underlying LLM cost of reading the PDF, which cannot be avoided without switching to non-AI (regex/pattern) extraction.

Cell population uses the standard Excel Online (Business) 'Run script' (Office Scripts) action, not a Premium connector or a custom Azure Function — Office Scripts are included in standard Microsoft 365 licensing.
The flow's own trigger is Copilot Studio's native child-flow trigger, not a Premium HTTP Request trigger.

The agent enforces a 15 MB / 40-page cap, and now the full extraction + validation pass, before this flow is ever invoked — so this flow never runs, copies a file, or spends anything for an oversized, invalid, or unreadable upload.

This version intentionally creates one new file per review (per the bank's existing review-package convention) rather than appending to a shared workbook — the template copy and the one-time sharing-link creation are the per-run costs this design accepts in exchange for matching the team's existing template/workflow.

trigger.description: Native 'When Copilot Studio calls a flow' trigger. No Premium HTTP Request trigger is used, so this flow does not require a Power Automate Premium license. Every input here is a value the agent has already extracted and validated in-conversation — this flow receives finished data, not a file to interpret.

collateralAnalysisValue.description: Numeric value as a string, or 'Not Stated' — the agent coalesces missing values before calling this flow.

appraiserNames.description: Already joined with '; ' by the agent — this flow does no array formatting.

outputs.description: Configured on the trigger's Outputs panel in the designer (see DEPLOYMENT.md) — each output is bound to an expression pointing at the corresponding Compose action below.

Format_City_State.description: Feeds cell F24, which holds city and state together.

Build_Destination_File_Name.description: One new file per review: '<street address, sanitized> - <yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>.xlsx'. The timestamp suffix guarantees uniqueness even for two reviews on the same property the same day.

Copy_Template_To_New_File.description: Copies the template designated in parameters.templateSiteUrl / parameters.templateFilePath to parameters.destinationSiteUrl / parameters.destinationFolderPath, under the name built above. 'If another file already exists' is set to Rename as a safety net, since the timestamp suffix already makes a collision very unlikely.

Get_New_File_Properties.description: Resolves the drive/item identifiers of the newly copied file from the path Copy_Template_To_New_File returns — the Run Script and Create Sharing Link actions need these identifiers, not just a path.

Populate_Review_Cells.description: Runs flows/scripts/PopulateAppraisalReviewCells.ts against the new file (added once to the file/library via Excel Online > Automate, see DEPLOYMENT.md). All parameters are passed as strings, straight from the trigger — the agent already coalesced missing values to 'Not Stated' before calling this flow, so no further defaulting happens here.

Create_Sharing_Link.description: Generates a fresh link for this specific new file (unlike a shared tracker, every review is a distinct file, so there is no static link to reuse).

Build_Review_Summary.inputs: @concat(coalesce(triggerBody()?['streetAddress'], 'Address not stated'), ', ', outputs('Format_City_State'), ' — ', coalesce(triggerBody()?['occupancyType'], 'occupancy not stated'), ', collateral value ', coalesce(triggerBody()?['collateralAnalysisValue'], 'not stated'))

Handle_Write_Failure.description: Fires if the file copy, cell population, or sharing-link step failed — most commonly a misconfigured templateFilePath/destinationFolderPath parameter, the Office Script not present on the copied file, or a sheet name mismatch ('RE Collateral'). Extraction has already succeeded by the time this flow runs, so a failure here is always a write-path problem, never a reading-the-PDF problem.

inputs.errorMessage: @coalesce(actions('Populate_Review_Cells')?['error']?['message'], actions('Copy_Template_To_New_File')?['error']?['message'], actions('Get_New_File_Properties')?['error']?['message'], actions('Create_Sharing_Link')?['error']?['message'], 'The extracted data could not be written to a new workbook. Check the template/destination parameters and the Office Script.')

templateSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site that hosts the bank's own appraisal review template workbook (sheet 'RE Collateral'). Designate this to point at wherever your team actually keeps the template — this flow does not ship a template of its own.

templateFilePath.description: Server-relative path to the template file within templateSiteUrl, e.g. /sites/CreditRisk/Shared Documents/Templates/Appraisal Review Template.xlsx.

destinationSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site where completed, per-review workbooks should be saved. Can be the same site as the template or a different one.

destinationFolderPath.description: Server-relative destination folder path within destinationSiteUrl, e.g. /sites/CreditRisk/Shared Documents/Appraisal Reviews.
